articles.title: A Giant X-Ray Flash May Have Revealed a Brand-New Magnetar
articles.summary: Astronomers saw a giant X-ray flash that lasted 10 minutes — way longer than normal. They think it came from two super-dense stars crashing together and forming a magnetar, a star with a magnetic field billions of times stronger than Earth's.

articles.title: World's Smallest Crocodiles Caught on Camera Hunting Bats in a Cave
articles.summary: For the first time, scientists filmed dwarf crocodiles sneaking up on bats in a pitch-black cave in Gabon. The crocs live in bat poop, have orange skin, and are evolving in a totally wild way.

articles.title: Swiss Glaciers Are Melting Fast — and It's Getting Worse
articles.summary: Switzerland's glaciers lost 5.5% of their ice this year, the second-biggest drop ever. In just five years, they've shrunk by nearly a fifth. Scientists say human-caused warming is to blame.
